status: Phase B d1 (2026-09-23). venue.notes: 2026 home venue: Hard Rock Stadium (the retail model is Pro Player Stadium, the same site). End zones (2025-26 Hard Rock photos): aqua paint, the white Dolphins wordmark outlined in orange, the full-colour logo beside it; the same at both ends (s14 has separate south textures, given the same art). s14 has no midfield texture, so the center_logo item has nowhere to go until u4's native fix. Walls: aqua pads with the 2013 logo, the Dolphins wordmark and the current NFL shield and AFC logo; boards: only the team cells (Dolphins wordmark, GO DOLPHINS ribbon, the old slogan panel) are replaced, sponsors stay.
